title: Critical Social Work Practice
description: Explores the application of critical social work practice from a decolonial, anti-racist, anti-oppressive social justice framework in various contexts. Students: deepen their critical self-reflection on how positionality informs practice; critically analyze social work practice- including the interrogation of mainstream practice approaches; enrich their understanding and application of various critical social work practice approaches that reflect the values and goals of decolonial equity; and contribute to a critically reflective, collaborative learning environment.
